Our Story

From Ramallah to Warren Ave.

Al-Nour's story starts in Ramallah, Palestine, where the family's first bakery opened, and still bakes today. In 1992 the family brought it to Dearborn, opening their first location on Schaefer. Today father and son fire up the brick oven on W. Warren every morning before sunrise.

Regulars come back for the Akkawi cheese manousheh and the egg & cheese pie. Step inside and you'll see where it all comes from: hand-stitched tatreez, the Dome of the Rock, Palestine on the walls.

Good to know

What should I order on my first visit?

Start with a za'atar & cheese pie, then grab a dozen spinach or meat fatayer for the table. Regulars swear by the Akkawi cheese manousheh and the sujuk & cheese.

Do you do catering or large orders?

Yes. Office breakfasts, family gatherings and events. Use the tray builder above or call (313) 945-5598, ideally a day ahead for big orders. Ask us about shipping arrangements too.

Can I get delivery?

Order through DoorDash or Uber Eats where available, or order pickup on Grubhub. Calling ahead for pickup is fastest.

What are your hours?

Every day, 5:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Come early for the widest selection.
